content: License landscape: all Plan 9 releases relicensed to MIT by Plan 9 Foundation (2021-03-23). Harvey's top-level LICENSE is MIT (Plan 9 Foundation 2021); LICENSE.gpl applies ONLY to ghostscript printer fonts; LICENSE.old is historic LPL 1.02. 9front is MIT (project statement on 9fans: '9front kept licensing with MIT'). 0intro/9-cc NOTICE is MIT-grant text with Lucent/Vita Nuova/CH Forsyth copyrights. MIT->MIT (and MIT->GPL, if needed) are compatible; no blockers for importing 9front/9-cc code into Harvey. Harvey LICENSE file read directly; 9-cc NOTICE fetched directly; 9front MIT per 9fans statement (weaker evidence).
